- Working tree (uncommitted) on HEAD b28919d is source of truth. Single stack, root manifest `package.json` (bun@1.4.2); no `[MULTI_STACK]`. 52 inventory entries.
- Excluded: `.claude/`, `plans/`, `docs/`, `node_modules/`, `.next/`, `test-results/`, `graphify-out/`, `bun.lock`, `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`. Also not inventoried: generated `next-env.d.ts`, `supabase/.gitignore` (outside the declared scope, ignore-rules only).
- Type tags beyond the template list, per task contract: `test` (all `e2e/**`). Static assets (`public/images/**`, `app/favicon.ico`, `app/globals.css`) are tagged `other` (no asset tag in the template). Presentational/client components under `app/login/_components/`, `app/login/*-container.tsx`, `app/todo/logout-button.tsx` are tagged `other` (sub-regions of the two screens, not standalone screens). `app/page.tsx` is tagged `route` (redirect only, no UI).
- Next.js 16.4.0 App Router, React 19.3.0, Tailwind 4 (`@tailwindcss/turbopack`), `@supabase/ssr` ~0.12.7, `@supabase/supabase-js` ^2.117.3. Per `AGENTS.md` this is NOT stock Next.js: `proxy.ts` replaces `middleware.ts`; `next.config.ts` sets `cacheComponents: true`, `partialPrefetching: true`; `app/layout.tsx` exports `instant = false`; `refresh()` from `next/cache` used in the server action; `PageProps<'/login'>` / `LayoutProps<'/'>` typed globals; request-time APIs (`cookies()`, `searchParams`, `connection()`) wrapped in `<Suspense>`.
- Path alias `@/*` -> `./*` (tsconfig). No barrel files. No `src/` dir.

### Routes (for route/API/flow waves)
| Route | Kind | File | Behaviour |
|-------|------|------|-----------|
| `/` | page (redirect) | `app/page.tsx` | `redirect("/login")`; signed-in users then forwarded to `/todo` by proxy |
| `/login` | page (screen) | `app/login/page.tsx` | Server component; reads locale cookie + `?error=`; non-empty `error` -> fixed inline alert (text never rendered, F001:BR-001); layout in `app/login/_components/*` |
| `/todo` | page (screen, protected) | `app/todo/page.tsx` | `connection()` then `supabase.auth.getUser()`; no user -> `redirect('/login')` (defense in depth); shows `data-testid="todo-email"` + logout form |
| `/auth/callback` | route handler `GET` | `app/auth/callback/route.ts` | OAuth PKCE code exchange. `?error=*`, missing `code`, or `code.length > 2048` -> 307 `Location: /login?error=auth_failed`; `exchangeCodeForSession` ok -> 307 `/todo`, fail/throw -> `/login?error=auth_failed`. Relative Location (no open redirect), `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `next` param never read (DEC-002/BR-002, BR-001) |
| `/auth/logout` | route handler `POST` | `app/auth/logout/route.ts` | Native form POST. `getUser()` then `signOut({scope:'local'})`; on failure/throw deletes cookies matching `sb-*-auth-token*`; always 303 `Location: /login`, `no-store`. Only `POST` exported -> `GET`/others return 405 (Next default) so a GET cannot log out |

Server action: `setLocale(raw)` in `lib/i18n/set-locale-action.ts` (`'use server'`; wired by `app/login/language-selector-container.tsx` via `useTransition`). Invalid locale or same-as-current -> silent no-op; else sets cookie `NEXT_LOCALE` (path `/`, maxAge 1y, SameSite=Lax) then `refresh()`. Not a route; no URL.

### Session guard (Permissions, not BL)
- `proxy.ts` (matcher: everything except `_next/static`, `_next/image`, `favicon.ico`, and `*.svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp`) delegates to `updateSession()` in `lib/supabase/proxy.ts`.
- `updateSession`: `/auth/*` -> `NextResponse.next()` untouched (BR-003, callback finishes exchange); else builds `createServerClient` with request/response cookie bridge, calls `supabase.auth.getUser()` (never `getSession()`, DEC-001; Auth-server errors fail closed = signed out). No user + path `/todo` or `/todo/*` -> redirect `/login` (query stripped); user + `/login` -> redirect `/todo`; every redirect copies refreshed cookies + Supabase cache headers (BR-004).
- Middleware/proxy here is authentication -> belongs in Permissions artifact, excluded from BL `middleware` category per bl-source-patterns.md.
- Defense in depth also in `app/todo/page.tsx` (getUser check).

### Auth / Supabase
- Browser client `lib/supabase/client.ts` (`createBrowserClient`); server client `lib/supabase/server.ts` (`createServerClient` + `next/headers` cookies, one client per call); `lib/auth/sign-in-with-google.ts` -> `signInWithOAuth({provider:'google', redirectTo: <origin>/auth/callback})`, same-tab PKCE, never throws, returns `{ok}`.
- Client state machine `app/login/google-login-container.tsx`: `idle | initiating | error`; resets on `pageshow` persisted (bfcache); focus returns to button on failure.
- No DB tables, no ORM, no SQL migrations, no `public` schema usage in app code (only `supabase/config.toml`; `[db.seed]` points to `./seed.sql` which does not exist). Model category: no model files. Data entity at runtime = Supabase Auth `User` (email shown on `/todo`).
- `supabase/config.toml`: project_id `agentic-coding-hands-on`; api 54321, db 54322, studio 54323, local_smtp 54324; auth `site_url` http://localhost:3000, `additional_redirect_urls` http://localhost:3000/**, `jwt_expiry` 3600; `[auth.external.google]` enabled, `client_id`/`secret` from `env(SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID|_SECRET)` (live in git-ignored `supabase/.env`).

Keys: `meta.title`, `login.*`, `language.*`, `todo.*`. `app/layout.tsx` sets `<html lang>` and `<title>` from locale. Fonts: Geist/Geist Mono (layout), Montserrat + Montserrat Alternates (`app/login/_components/login-fonts.ts`).
